posts.name: Zaryab Qureshi
posts.cooked:
Run the following commands to stop Redis, Node, and Python processes, then restart the bench:

sudo pkill -9 -f redis
sudo pkill -9 -f node
sudo pkill -9 -f python

After that, restart your bench.
